tei:div.tei:p: bod du bstan pa phyi dar dang*/ mkhas grub sdai dgon byung tshul bzhugs so/ /

e ma ho/ chos rgyal mes dbon mkhyen brtse'i nam mkha' la/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma bod kyi yul du gsal/ /sdig chen dar ma'i dgra can gdong pa yis/ /chu mo phag nas drug cu rtsa brgyad bar/ /mun pa'i rgyal khams bzhin du nag por bsgribs/ /bod khams phal cher bstan pa'i sgra mi grags/ /bstan 'dzin thams cad gab dang bros la rtsol/ /dbus gtsang mthil du chos min sna tshogs dar/ /rgyal khrims chen po'ang rang gi spyod par thal/ /de la rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bzod par/ /mnga' bdag tsha la na yi thugs rgyud bskul/ /bla chen spyan sngar chos zhu rim par brdzangs/ /bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang tshul dang*/ /phyi dar rgyas pa byung tshul 'di ltar snang/ zha lu bu ston chos rje'i chos 'byung la/ /bod yul kha ba can gyi yul ljongs 'dir/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyi dar byung tshul ni/ sdig rgyal glang dar mar grags pa de nyid/ chu mo lug lo sum cu so dgu lon pa'i dus/ mnga' bdag khri ral grongs nas/ khong gis rgyal srid bzung*/ lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin sgrub/ chu mo phag gi lo gzhug nas thugs la gdon gsol ba dang*/ blon po rgyal to re stag sna can la sogs pa sdig pa la dga' ba rnams kyis bsgyur nas/ sngar nu bo la rgyal srid bskaus pa'i snying nad du byas/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs/ lo phyed dang bzhir sdig rgyal kho na byas/ zhe bzhi lon pa me pho stag gi lo'i dus/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes/ lha sa'i rdo ring rtsa ru glang dar ma bkrongs so/ /de'i dus su 'jad kyi mi gtsang rab gsal dang*/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung*/ stod lung pa dmar shākya mu ne gsum po/ dpal chu bo ri la sgom zhing yod pas na btsun pas khyi ra byed pa mthong te/ dris pas rgyal pos bstan pa bsnubs par shes te/ 'dul ba'i po ti drel khal gcig bkal nas mnga' ris stod du braus/ gar log la lam byas nas hor yul du phyin la/

chos dar bar bya snyam pa la/ skad rigs mi gcig lo tsā med pas dar bar ma nus te/ mdo smad lho dngos kyi be ra tshwa mtsho na tshur byung nas/ rma lung rdo rje brag ra/ an byung gnam rdzong/ dan tig shel kyi yang dgon du slebs/ sgom zhing yod pa la/ rma chu kha'i phyugs rdzis mthong nas yul mi la smras pa/ bon po'i grub thob/ mu zu gsal bzang bya ba'i bu lo bco lnga lon pa/ las dang skal ba ldan zhing mos pa la spyod pa'i/ dpal dmu zu gsal 'bar gyi tshor nas/ ltar phyin pas mthong ba tsam gyi dad nas/ rab tu byung ba zhus pa la/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya'i po ti bstan nas/ 'di la ltos/ 'di ltar rab tu byung na gsungs/ bltas pas shin du dad te mchi ma byung ngo*/ /der gtsang gis mkhan po/ g.yos slob dpon byas nas rab tu byung dge tshul gyi ming*/ mkhan slob dang sbyar nas dge ba rab gsal du btags so/ /phyis thugs rab che bas/ dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de nas lo 'ga' song ba dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs zhus dus/ dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi yong gsungs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje na re/ ngas rgyal po bsad pas byar mi rung gzhan nas btsal gyis rgya nag ha shang ke wang dang*/ gyi ban bya ba btang byung ba dang*/ mkhan slob dang dmar gy-is gsang ston/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis pos kha skong byas te lnga tshogs kyis bsnyen rdzogs byas so/ /de nas lo lnga lon pa dang*/ bsam yas na yum brtan gyi rgyal rgyud/ mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras kyis/ mdo smad na rab byung yod pa'i rgyu mtshan tshor nas/ dbus gtsang gi mi shes rab dang snying rus che rnams/ chos 'tshol ba la nges par btang dgos dgongs par shar te/ dbus nas glags pa lam pa/ klu mes shes rab tshul khrims dang*/ 'bre ye shes yon tan/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga/ gtsang nas/ mgur mo rab kha ba/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug

shab sgo mnga' ba'i tshong btsun shes rab seng ge mnga' ris pa 'od rgyal spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa lte dkar ba dang lnga stai/ mi bcu po de khams la brdzangs nas/ gtsang g.yo dmar gsum la/ bka' drin zhus pas/ gtsang na re/ nged rgas pas mkhan po mi 'khyongs/ bla ma chen po la zhus gsungs/ bla chen gyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ lo lnga las ma lon pas na/ mkhan po mi gtub zer ba la| gtsang na re/ dmigs bsal la gtub pas gyis gsung nas/ bla chen gyis mkhan po/ gtsang g.yos las slob dang gsang ston byas/ dmar dang ha shang gis kha skong byas te/ thams cad chig rdzogs byas so/ /de nas bla chen gyi zhal nas da khyed rnams yar song la/ dbus gtsang du bstan pa dar ba zhig gal che'o/ /de'ang lo ston mthu che bas bstan bsrung gyis/ klu mes sku btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong dge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring kha bkod mkhas pas gnas gzhi zung gsungs nas byin po yar yong*/ klu mes kyis gnubs ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba nyan cing bsdad do/ /de nas yar yong ba rnams kyis/ ldan klong thang du slebs dus/ lo ston na re/ khyed tsho 'di khar sdod cig ngas dbus gtsang du phyin la bstan pa dar nus mi nus brtag stai/ nus na bsdad kyi mi nus na nga yang log yong gis gsungs nas/ ldan ma'i tshong pa dang 'graugs te yar byon/ de'i phyi lo klu mes kyis kyang*/ slob dpon la zhus nas yar byon pa dang*/ lo ston gyi khong rnams la bsu ba la byon pas/ thams cad dbus su 'dzoms nas/ yar byon pa dang*/ bsam yas su mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras dang mjal lo/ /sdig rgyal glang dar mas chu mo phag nas bstan pa bsnubs/ khong rang gi lo mang ma thub kyang*/ de'i smon lam log pa dang*/ las ngan shugs ches pas/ lo drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la/ bstan pa'i ming med pa'i dus su/ dbus gtsang gnyis gyi mi bcu po bsam yas su slebs/ rgyal pos bkur sti dang bya dga' chen po mdzad/

bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs te/ nyin mo ltar gsal zhing*/ dar rgyas che bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos bka' gnang*/ khong rnams gros mthun par dbus gtsang gi sa char/ rten lha khang bzhengs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sdai 'dzugs par chad bsdams te/ klu mes kyis/ sngar sor la mo phyag de'u brtsigs/ gzhu kun dga' ra ba dang*/ tsha mig brtsigs/ 'bring ngan lam spyil mo dang*/ snye thang brag sna brang ra mo che brtsigs/ sbas kyis gzhung nya mo gyur dang*/ lan pa spyil bu brtsigs/ rakshi'i 'phrang po lha khang dang*/ sum pas 'gro swa thang dang*/ rme ru brtsigs/ khong rnams kyi slaub ma yang slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs so// gtsang du lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong brtsigs/ rgya shākya gzhon nu dang*/ 'gos g.yag srung la sogs pa bu chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung*/ a mes tshong btsun shes rab seng ges/ rtsig gi yang dben brtsigs/ zhang ston mtshal 'phags la sogs/ slob ma yang mang dag byung bas/ de rnams kyi dge 'dun gyi sde lha khang tshan che ba bzhengs/ mgo g.yag gi slob ma/ lce btsun sher 'byung gis zha lu 'a mo bzhengs/ de ltar khams su dbus gtsang gi mi bcus phyin kyang*/ sum pa dang 'o rgyang spun la mched pa med cing*/ 'a 'bring gnyis de rnams la ma gtogs zer ro/ /a mes bla ma chen mo dang*/ mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu po dang bcas pa de rnams/ bod kha ba can pa la shin tu nas kyang sku drin che'o/ /der rting bod rgyal 'od srung rgyud/ lha bla ma ye shes khu dbon rnams kyis rje btsun gha ya dha ra dang*/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha pha dam pa/ paṇa chen shākya shri la sogs/ rgya bal gyi lo paṇa mang po gdan drangs pa dang*/ bod yul du 'khrungs pa'i bla ma sa skya khu dbon/ lo chen rin bzang*/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/ dwags po dang shangs pa bka' rgyud pa la sogs/

lo paṇa mkhas grub bzang la mang ba/ rim par byon pa rnams bshad nyan sgom sgrub kyis bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pas/ bstan pa rin po che gangs la nyi ma shar ba lta bu gsal zhing dngas par bzhugs pa lags so/ /bstan pa phyi dar dar tshul 'di bris pas// bstan pa'i chu rgyun rgyun ring gnas pa dang*/ /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog mchog tu yar 'phel nas/ / bstan zhugs 'gro kun kun mkhyen thob par shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/bod du bstan pa phyi dar dang mkhas grub sde dgon byung tshul/ -PAGE 234--PAGE 235--PAGE 233-
